nameOrigin: the deep chime of a bell

pokedexEntries.di: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

pokedexEntries.prl: It can summon rain clouds. People long ago revered it as the bringer of plentiful harvests.

pokedexEntries.pt: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

pokedexEntries.hgss: Ancient people believed that petitioning BRONZONG for rain was the way to make crops grow.
